experiment_data.hypothesis: T=1.2 will decrease degeneracy rate and expand LP range vs T=1.0, but may degrade generation quality (lower greedy F1). Tests whether reducing degeneracy via higher T recovers selection headroom or if quality degradation offsets the benefit.
